snippet.title: DDoD Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468200/DDoD/

DDoD is a top-down roguelite shooter with survival elements, built around a massive map. Play solo or team up with a few other players for co-op runs.

You arrive at the edge of the Purple Lands - a sealed-off industrial region struck by a sentient, mind-like substance known as the Fog. Exposure twists DNA in unpredictable ways. The cautious and the careful sometimes gain abilities no human was meant to have… but everything has a price.

Your journey leads to the very heart of the industrial wasteland. Across swamps, forests, and dead towns - to the source. Along the way, you’ll scavenge, customize your weapons, and push your luck further than it should ever go.

DDoD is coming to PC, PlayStation, and Xbox in 2026.
